question: Find the area of the iron sheet required to prepare a cone (with base) is 24 cm height with base radius 7 cm:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the cone has a base, the total iron sheet required equals its Total Surface Area (TSA).

Slant height (l) = √(r² + h²) = √(7² + 24²) = 25 cm.

TSA = π × r × (l + r)

⇒ TSA = (22 ÷ 7) × 7 × (25 + 7) = 22 × 32 = 704 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 704 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 

 

 

 
• 
 
• 
 

 h = 24 cm
 r = 7 cm
 l = 25 cm
 

**Given:**

⇒ Radius of the base (r) = 7 cm

⇒ Height of the cone (h) = 24 cm

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Slant height (l) = √(r² + h²)

⇒ Total Surface Area of cone = π × r × (l + r)

**Calculations:**

⇒ l = √(7² + 24²)

⇒ l = √(49 + 576) = √625 = 25 cm

⇒ Total Surface Area = (22 ÷ 7) × 7 × (25 + 7)

⇒ Total Surface Area = 22 × 32

⇒ Total Surface Area = 704 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 704 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area of a Cone

The surface area of the curved part alone (excluding the base) is calculated using the formula CSA = π × r × l.

Volume of a Cone

The volume inside the cone is given by V = (1 ÷ 3) × π × r² × h. It represents exactly one-third of a cylinder's volume with identical radius and height.

Pythagorean Triplets in Geometry

The measurements 7, 24, and 25 form a standard Pythagorean triplet since 7² + 24² = 25². Recognizing this avoids calculation steps for finding the slant height.
